assessment.rationale: The static analysis reveals a high-confidence malicious prediction (score 0.87 > threshold 0.83) supported by consistent PE characteristics such as stripped symbols and MFC42 imports.
limitations: Evidence is from an EMBER feature record rather than raw PE bytes, limiting the ability to confirm execution behavior.
Static analysis cannot verify runtime actions or payload delivery.
